preferences: When a task calls for the Megamind role, use roles.megamind.provider and roles.megamind.settings exactly as configured.
Use Claude Opus for UI/UX, writing, naming, and open-ended product or architectural judgment. Use Codex for implementation, repository research, debugging, and evidence-driven audits.
Use worktree isolation for parallel tasks that may write to the same repository. Use the current workspace for read-only work or explicitly coordinated edits.
Prefer audit agents that did not implement the change so reviews remain independent.
Agents should read repository instructions, preserve unrelated user changes, run focused verification proportional to risk, and report concrete evidence with their conclusions.
